spec.name: Dwarf Blacksmith at the Anvil
spec.description: A squat, barrel-chested Warcraft-style dwarf blacksmith with a braided orange beard, raised hammer and leather apron, working a glowing iron bar on an anvil set on a wooden stump.
spec.layout: Two figures share the frame: the dwarf stands on the left-centre at x = -0.25 facing +Z (his face reads from the front), the anvil-on-stump sits to his right at x = +0.45, z = +0.25, on the floor. The dwarf is squat and wide: boots and stubby legs from y = 0 to 0.52, a huge barrel torso 0.52-1.06 (nearly 0.6 m across the shoulders, wider at the belt-buckled belly), a big round head 1.04-1.35 crowned by a riveted steel helmet to y = 1.48. The signature beard is a huge orange wedge from cheek height down to y = 0.78 with two braided side-tresses bound in gold rings and a fat moustache over a round nose. Right arm (-X side) is raised high: shoulder (−0.52, 0.92), elbow above it (−0.62, 1.16), fist overhead at (−0.48, 1.42) gripping a heavy hammer whose steel head swings up to y ≈ 1.7 behind the shoulder — the silhouette's high point. Left arm reaches forward-down to the anvil: elbow at (0.10, 0.68, 0.22), hand at the work point (0.30, 0.78, 0.34) holding tongs on a glowing orange iron bar lying across the anvil face. The anvil part is simple compared to the dwarf: dark stump cylinder r 0.19, iron anvil body 0.35-0.75 with a horn pointing +Z and a pale steel face plate, plus a small ember bucket with glowing coals at its base and two resting tools on the ground beside it. Style shows everywhere as chunky readable shapes: gold-trimmed belt and helmet band, rivets as tiny studs, iron brow-band, soot-dark hands, warm skin on top shading darker below, ember glow lighting the anvil face.

parts.builds: Two short, sturdy legs and boots, floor: thick boot shafts in dark leather with folded-over leather cuffs and steel toe caps, each boot a chunky block 0.22 wide centred at x = -0.42 and x = -0.08, z = 0, from y = 0 up to a knee at y = 0.36; blue-grey cloth trousers above the boots with a small gold buckle strap at each shin top; knees as rounded iron-dark pads; the legs meet the hips mount at y = 0.52 under the torso.
parts.attaches: Top of the legs meets the torso part at the hips mount [-0.25, 0.52, 0]; boots rest flat on y = 0.

parts.builds: The dwarf's massive barrel torso: a near-cylindrical chest and belly from y = 0.52 to 1.06, widest at the belly (about 0.56 across x), wearing a red cloth tunic with blue-grey sleeves rolled off view, over it a long brown leather blacksmith's apron falling from chest to hips with a darker leather edge trim and two front ties; a broad dark-leather belt at y = 0.62 carrying a big round gold buckle with an inner bronze ring at the belly front; small gold-studded straps crossing the chest; a thick fur-like collar ring of beard-coloured tuft at the shoulders where the head sits on the neck mount.
parts.attaches: Bottom sits over the legs part at the hips mount; shoulders meet the arms part along the shoulderLine mount; top closes onto the head part at the neck mount.

parts.builds: Head and face, the character's hero piece: a big round warm-skinned head (about 0.3 across) on the neck mount, with a broad squashed nose, small dark ink eyes set under heavy bushy dark-orange brows, a wide grinning mouth line, rosy cheeks, and big rounded ears stuck out at the sides; a huge triangular beard of stacked dark-orange tuft blocks from cheek height down to y = 0.78 with a lighter orange upper layer, a fat rolled moustache over the lip, and two long side-tresses braided from three tapering strands each, bound with two gold rings apiece; a steel helmet dome with a flared rim, a gold band studded with rivets, and a small gold nose-guard ridge down the front; a thin iron nose-ring in one nostril as a Warcraft flourish.
parts.attaches: Sits on the torso part at the neck mount [-0.25, 1.04, 0.02]; jaw joint at [-0.25, 0.98, 0.09] holds the lower jaw and the beard's front root.

parts.builds: Both arms, hands and tools. Right arm raised to strike: a thick frustum upper arm from shoulderR to elbowR, a forearm from elbowR to handR, clad in a blue-grey sleeve with a rolled cuff, ending in a big soot-dark fist with four finger blocks and a leather vambrace; the fist grips a vertical wood-shaft hammer whose head is a massive steel block with a bevelled face, dark iron bands at the cheeks and a bronze pommel ring, the head topping out near y = 1.7 behind the right shoulder. Left arm reaches down-forward to the anvil: sleeve, cuff, soot-dark fist around a pair of iron tongs whose jaws close on the glowing iron bar seated on the anvil's face at the anvilWorkPoint mount; a small iron wrist-guard ring on the left forearm.
parts.attaches: Shoulders hang off the torso part along the shoulderLine mount [-0.25, 0.92, 0] at shoulderR and shoulderL; the left tongs grip the glowing bar at the anvilWorkPoint mount [0.4, 0.74, 0.28] owned by the anvil part.

parts.builds: The anvil scene, kept simpler than the dwarf: a dark wooden stump cylinder r 0.19 from y = 0 to 0.35 at (0.45, 0, 0.25) with two iron hooping bands and a chipped top edge; the iron anvil body on it from y = 0.35 to 0.75 with a long tapered horn pointing +Z, a pale steel face plate on top, a hardy hole, and dark iron feet; a glowing orange-hot iron bar with a bright yellow-white core lying across the face plate, its glow colour radiating on the steel beneath; at the stump's base a small squat iron ember bucket with a heaped coal top and two glowing embers, plus two resting hand tools (a small mallet and a punch) lying on the ground beside it.
parts.attaches: Stands alone on the floor; its face plate carries the glowing bar at the anvilWorkPoint mount [0.4, 0.74, 0.28] where the arms part's tongs land.
